changes.en: New: Writing progress — every document (Word, PowerPoint, PDF, Markdown, text) gets a Progress tab charting its word count across all saved versions, with today's and this week's gain (Chinese is counted by character)
changes.zh: 新功能：写作进度——每个文档（Word、PowerPoint、PDF、Markdown、文本）都有“进度”标签，用图表显示所有已保存版本的字数变化，以及今天和本周新增的字数（中文按字计算）

changes.en: The Writing view lists the documents you worked on this week, most words added first, each with a small trend line
changes.zh: “写作进度”视图列出本周编辑过的文档，按新增字数排序，每个都带有趋势小图

changes.en: Versions with a note stand out as larger dots in the progress chart
changes.zh: 带备注的版本在进度图中显示为较大的圆点
